# Attribution patterns rejected anywhere in this repository.
#
# Each entry is a regular expression, deliberately written so the file does not
# contain the literal phrase it detects. A bracketed character class such as
# [-] still matches a plain hyphen, so "Co-authored[-]by:" catches a real
# trailer while this file itself stays clean under the owner's global commit
# guard, which scans every staged file including this one.
#
# scripts/validate-os.sh proves each pattern still fires against a constructed
# canary before it reports a pass, so blunting one of these is a validation
# failure rather than a silent gap.

Co-authored[-]by:
co-authored[-]by:
Generated[-]by:
generated[-]by:
AI[-]generated
ai[-]generated
AI[-]assisted
ai[-]assisted
[Cc]reated with AI
[Pp]owered by AI
\b[Bb]ot account\b
